analysis.title: Adyen NV (ADYEN.AS): 3Q26 results: Topline modestly ahead; downgrading FY26 and mid-term margin guidance; Buy
key_insights: Adyen 3Q26 net revenue was EUR 738.1mn, up 22% yoy ex-fx (c.20% organic), 1% above GSe (EUR 733.6mn) and consensus (EUR 731.2mn).
Management reiterated FY26 topline guidance of 21-23% net revenue growth ex-fx including M&A, and cut FY26 adjusted EBITDA margin guidance to c.50% from c.52% as it accelerates investment.
Management withdrew its mid-term EBITDA margin objective of above 55% by FY28. GSe FY28 margin was 57.2% and consensus 55.2%. Goldman awaits the call for the pace and areas of investment.
GS expects mid-single-digit cuts to FY26 EBITDA consensus forecasts, all else equal, after the margin guide-down.
Transaction volume was EUR 451.1bn, up 30% yoy (29% ex-fx), 2% above GSe and 4% above consensus. Net take rate was 0.164%, below GSe 0.166% and consensus 0.168%, down 5% yoy.

Digital net revenue grew 14% yoy ex-fx, driven by wallet share gains with the largest customers and strength in travel & mobility and content & subscriptions. Digital net revenue of EUR 387.4mn was 2% below GSe.
Unified Commerce net revenue grew 27% yoy ex-fx on wallet share gains in a subdued retail environment, plus a contribution from Talon.One. Net revenue of EUR 250.5mn was 1% above GSe.
Platforms net revenue grew 44% yoy ex-fx to EUR 100.2mn, 9% above GSe. Platform customers processing over EUR 1bn accelerated to 46 from 37 last quarter.

Adyen added 177 underlying net new FTEs in 3Q26 and 399 through the Talon.One and Orb acquisitions. FY26 net adds target is now 1,000-1,100 including acquisitions, with the underlying 550-650 target unchanged.
Implied 4Q26 revenue growth is c.24% yoy ex-fx (c.22% organic), broadly in line with GSe and consensus.
GS keeps a Buy with a 12-month price target of EUR 1,750 (EUR 944 close on 27 Oct 2026, 85.4% upside), based on 50% DCF (EUR 1,775) and 50% multiple valuation (EUR 1,725, c.22x 3Q27-2Q28E EV/EBITDA).

Key questions for the call: exit 4Q26 growth and FY27 trajectory, regional operating environment, Platforms ramp, margin path without a mid-term guide, embedded finance traction, FCF given elevated capex, and capital allocation policy.

market_movers.rationale: Goldman keeps Buy on Adyen after 3Q26 despite the FY26 EBITDA margin guide-down and withdrawal of the FY28 margin target. The price target is EUR 1,750, versus EUR 1,850 set in August 2026.

earnings_insights: Adyen 3Q26 reported net revenue EUR 738.1mn (+23% yoy, +22% ex-fx, +20% organic ex-fx) vs GSe EUR 733.6mn and Visible Alpha consensus EUR 731.2mn.

3Q26 reported transaction volume EUR 451.1bn vs GSe EUR 442.5bn and consensus EUR 435.6bn. Reported net take rate 0.164% vs GSe 0.166% and consensus 0.168%. Incremental take rate 0.134% vs GSe 0.142% and consensus 0.150%.

FY26 guidance: net revenue growth 21-23% ex-fx including M&A (unchanged), adjusted EBITDA margin c.50% (previously c.52%). GSe FY26 adjusted EBITDA is EUR 1,494.2mn at a 52.0% margin and consensus is EUR 1,489.9mn at 51.9%.
FY26 estimates: GSe net revenue EUR 2,874.8mn (+21.6% yoy) vs consensus EUR 2,870.4mn. GSe FY26E EPS is EUR 38.73.
Medium-term: net revenue growth guide of c.20% is unchanged. The adjusted EBITDA margin guide (previously c.55% or higher by FY28) is discontinued.
risk_factors: Higher opex and talent recruitment costs for global expansion.
Competition from incumbents and new entrants.
